name: tileforge-studio
tileforgeReleaseNotes: Classic studio puts Tiles, Collision and Events in one clear navigation row, with more room for the map.
Show all tilesets starts enabled. Browse every compatible project pair in the right-hand palette, or tap Interior/Exterior to narrow the list.
Tile thumbnails load as you scroll. Search includes tile names, IDs, source tilesets and locations.
Selecting artwork from another pair previews the whole map before Apply. The change has Undo and keeps collision and elevation.
Collision uses Walkable/Blocked brushes by default; raw fields and combined height presets are in Advanced movement.
Green/red movement overlays keep elevation numbers optional. Occasional map tools stay under Tools & tasks.
